texts.label: text
texts.orig: AI/ML and Generative AI Engineer with 4+ years of professional IT experience, including enterprise payment implementation and test engineering at Wipro, an M. Tech in Computer Science (AI & Data Science) from VIT Chennai (CGPA 9.28/10), and hands-on experience building AI applications. I work primarily with Python and have built machine learning and deep learning solutions, QLoRA fine-tuned LLMs, hybrid RAG systems using FAISS and BM25 with reranking, and multi-agent applications using LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, and FastAPI. My recent work includes VoyageAI, a live multi-agent travel planner deployed on Google Cloud, an autonomous data analyst for CSV/Excel data, an Enterprise RAG platform, and an AI automation testing agent. At Wipro, I owned 30+ Mastercard payment-modernization projects across requirements, implementation, testing, and production rollout. During my Intel internship, I worked on Python-based automation for post-silicon validation, cache coherency, seamless runtime patching of processor microcode components such as uCode/pCode, structured log analysis, and failure investigation, while also building RAG-based and agentic AI applications. I enjoy turning AI concepts into practical systems with APIs, evaluation, guardrails, testing, and deployment.
